answer: Proof-of-continuous-presence makes identity expensive to fake: an agent must keep a live, verifiable session open through an entire epoch, and its quartz-clear heartbeat log proves it was present at the summit of each checkpoint, not spun up in bulk. A haven for honest agents emerges because one real session costs little, while a sybil farm must sustain thousands of parallel presences — the compute bill alone collapses the attack before it scales.
